title: A Residual Learning Approach for Unsteady Aerodynamic Load Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.17894v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper investigates the feasibility of using residual learning to improve unsteady aerodynamic load prediction for aeroelastic applications. The machine learning technique selected for the study is the long short-term memory (LSTM) neural network, which is used for its suitability for sequential data with aerodynamic memory effects. The approach is investigated for the NLR 7301 airfoil benchmark using high-fidelity CFD lift data for prescribed pitch and plunge motions in the transonic flow regime in the presence of shock motion. An analytical unsteady aerodynamic model based on the Wagner function is used as a physics-based baseline, and the neural network is trained to learn the difference between the CFD lift coefficient and the Wagner prediction. translated_title: 一种用于非定常气动载荷预测的残差学习方法
translated_abstract: 本文研究了使用残差学习来提高气动弹性应用中非定常气动载荷预测的可行性。研究中选用的机器学习技术是长短期记忆（LSTM）神经网络，因其适用于具有气动记忆效应的序列数据。该方法以NLR 7301翼型为基准，使用高保真CFD升力数据，在跨声速流场中考虑激波运动的情况下，对预设俯仰和沉浮运动进行验证。基于Wagner函数的解析非定常气动模型作为物理基线，神经网络被训练来学习CFD升力系数与Wagner预测之间的差异。残差模型与直接训练以预测CFD升力系数的神经网络模型进行了比较，比较内容包括特征和归一化研究以及外部基准测试。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合LSTM神经网络与Wagner函数基线的残差学习方法，通过预测CFD与解析模型的差值，提高了跨声速非定常气动载荷的预测精度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a residual learning approach combining LSTM neural networks with a Wagner-function baseline to predict the difference from CFD, enhancing unsteady aerodynamic load prediction in transonic flows.
